excerpt.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。

texts.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
texts.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

sections.zh:
当我们第一次离开母星系时，就遇到了一个迫使我们臣服的外星帝国。尽管对于人民而言这是一段痛苦的记忆，但事实证明这段附庸关系远比我们想象中有益得多，在这段短暂的附庸时光中，我们学到了不少东西。

我们并非宗主国唯一的附庸，因为我们已经接见了其他在宗主国控制下国家所派出的外交官和大使。虽然我们与其中的某些家伙看不对眼，但至少现在他们还是有用的盟友。

不过，我们虽然盼望着有朝一日能独立自主地决定自身的命运，但现在还是要接受当下的附属国地位，并充分利用目前的局面。
sections.en:
As we stepped out of our home system for the first time we were approached by a foreign empire who demanded our subjugation. Though a painful memory for our people, we have learned a lot in our short time as a vassal, with the relationship proving more beneficial than we could have hoped for.

We are not the only vassal of our new overlord, as we have had the chance to meet diplomats and ambassadors from some of the other empires under their thumb. We do not see quite eye to eye with some of them, but we believe they will prove to be useful allies for the time being.

Though we are looking forward to a day where we once again can decide our own future, we will accept our subject nature for now, and make the most of the situation we have been put in.

texts.zh:
欢迎你们，新外星人朋友们！

由于你们选择成为我们的……盟友，我们认为现在正是与你们联络的时候。你们选择了理性而不是逼迫我们使用暴力，这令我们非常愉快。
texts.en:
Welcome, dear newfound allies!

We felt it was only right to contact you now that you have chosen to partake in our... alliance. It pleases us you chose to see reason, rather than forcing our hand towards violence.

label.zh: 是你们让我们别无选择的不是么？
label.en: You didn't give us much of a choice, did you?

label.zh: 还有什么别的你们想告诉我们的吗？
label.en: Was there something you wanted to talk to us about?

label.zh: 我们以成为你们的一员而骄傲！
label.en: We are proud to be a part of your alliance!

texts.zh:
哼哼……无论如何！

经过深思熟虑，我们决定投资一大笔资源来援助你们的国家进行特化。在未来，这将让你们的帝国在我们所有的伙伴和盟友中扮演更加重要的角色。

我们还不太确定你们的人民更喜欢怎么样的角色，军事化？专精学术？或你们更感兴趣矿物和物质财富？
texts.en:
Hum hum... In any case!

After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.

We were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?

texts.zh:
我们同样骄傲于你们的到来！

经过深思熟虑，我们决定投资一大笔资源来援助你们的国家进行特化。在未来，这将让你们的帝国在我们所有的伙伴和盟友中扮演更加重要的角色。

我们还不太确定你们的人民更喜欢怎么样的角色，军事化？专精学术？或你们更感兴趣矿物和物质财富？
texts.en:
And we are proud to welcome you!

After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.

We were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?
So... Have you given it a second thought?

texts.en:
After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.

We were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?

label.zh: 军事专精听起来棒极了。
label.en: A military-focused deal sounds perfect.

label.zh: 能不能再详细介绍一下戍邦？
label.en: Could you tell us more about Bulwarks?

label.zh: 我们的人民更热爱学识。
label.en: Our people are more scholarly in nature.

label.zh: 我们更喜欢物质财富和矿物专精的特化。
label.en: We would like a material and mineral focused specialization.

texts.zh:
一种趋于暴力的倾向，是这样吗？

我们通常所说的戍邦是一种致力于军事事务的国家。这意味着我们会按月度支援你们一些基础的矿物和食物，这样你们国家可以将更多的精力放在战争上。

作为回报，我们希望你们可以为我们抵御外辱，在我们联盟的边境上扮演重要角色。这么说你们觉得可以接受吗？
texts.en:
A tendency towards violence, is that it?

A Bulwark, as we usually refer to them, are empires specialized in military affairs. It means we would support you with some basic minerals and food on a monthly basis so you could set aside a larger part of your empire to focus on war.

In turn, we expect you to help us defend against external threats, and play an important role at the borders of our allied space. Does that sound agreeable to you?

label.zh: 听起来是我们可以接受的。
label.en: That sounds like something we could live with.

label.zh: 我们需要再考虑考虑。
label.en: We would like to reconsider.

texts.zh:
所以这引起了你们的兴趣不是吗？

我们通常所说的学邦是一种专精于研究科技的国家。我们承诺保护你们的国家，而你们便可以集中资源让国家以及我们的盟友更加先进。

作为回报我们希望你们可以与我们其他国家分享所有令人惊奇的科学发现。这样的合约是否令你们满意？
texts.en:
So they have piqued your interest, have they?

A Scholarium, as they are known, is an empire specialized in science and research. We would pledge to protect your empire so you can focus most of your resources on advancing your empire and our allies alike.

In turn we expect you to share any peculiar peculiar technological breakthroughs you might have with the rest of us. Would that sort of contract work for you?

label.zh: 我们的人民乐于接受这项协定。
label.en: Our people would be happy with that deal.

label.zh: 我们需要再考虑考虑。
label.en: We would like to reconsider.

texts.zh:
你们对这项协定感兴趣没错吧？

勘探邦，正如大众赋予其称呼，是一种专精于发现矿物、生产战略资源的国家——但这会以牺牲他们的科学发展能力为代价。通过合适的工具，一些勘探邦可以找到其他人容易忽略的稀有矿物，尽管这只是我们道听途说的。

这听起来对你们的人民而言是不是一项可以胜任的工作呢？
texts.en:
Interested in that deal, are you?

A Prospectorium, as many call them, is an empire which specializes in finding minerals, and manufacturing strategic resources - but often at the cost of advancing their empire scientifically. With the right tools, some of the Prospectoria have been able to locate rare minerals that others overlook, though that's only a rumor we have heard.

Does that sound like something your people would be able to do?

label.zh: 我认为这非常适合我们。
label.en: We believe that is something that would fit us.

label.zh: 我们需要再考虑考虑。
label.en: We would like to reconsider.

texts.zh:
紧随着[overlord_ruler.GetName]的突然驾崩，我们获悉了[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上正经历的混乱。不太受支持的[overlord_heir.GetName]通过军事手段将王座纳入了[overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself]的囊中，令[overlord_heir.GetHisHer]的皇亲和[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上的人民们大为不满。

在[overlord_heir.GetFirstName]的引起骚乱的崛起之后，许多人开始质疑[Root.Overlord.GetName]统治我们的合法性。如果他们连自己首都的安全都无法保证，他们还有什么能耐来保护我们的安全？
texts.en:
We have received news about the ongoing chaos on [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName], following the sudden death of [overlord_ruler.GetName]. The unpopular [overlord_heir.GetName] has taken the throne for [overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself] with the help of the military, much to the chagrin of [overlord_heir.GetHisHer] siblings and the people of [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName].

After the troublesome rise of [overlord_heir.GetFirstName], many have started questioning the right of the [Root.Overlord.GetName] to dominion over us. If they cannot keep their own capital peaceful, what hope do they possibly have to keep the rest of us safe?

label.zh: 哪怕是天上的长堤，也是溃于蚁穴。
label.en: A starfish rots from the head down.

texts.zh:
失去了能够维持团结统一的伟大领袖，[previous_overlord.GetName]现已分崩离析，而每一部分都宣称自己才是原先帝国的正统。然而由于没有足够的实力和合法性，他们对所有附庸的控制也随之瓦解。

在每一个分裂的部分都在互相征伐，争夺[previous_overlord.GetName]的王位时，他们原先的附属国们也可以按自己的意愿行事了。
texts.en:
With no great leader to hold them together, the [previous_overlord.GetName] has dissolved into several parts, with each claiming their right to rule over the old empire. Without the strength or legitimacy of old however, their hold over all their vassals has crumbled to nothing.

With the disparate parts of the old empire fighting over the throne of the [previous_overlord.GetName], their old subjects are now free to do as they wish.

label.zh: 重获自由喽。
label.en: Free once more, then.

label.zh: 是时候有新的领袖登上历史舞台了。
label.en: It is time for a new leader to take charge.

label.zh: 我们忠于王座，无论如何。
label.en: We are loyal to the throne - no matter what.

texts.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]的人民对他们国土以外的事情漠不关心，不过他们清楚，无论外界发生了什么都可能会破坏他们一心一意的内部专注。因此他们向我们寻求如同原先[previous_overlord.GetName]所给予的类似的保护。
texts.en: The people of the [new_subject_target.GetName] care little for anything outside their own borders, but they are aware that whatever is out there might ruin their single-minded internal focus. Therefore they have turned to us for protection of the same kind the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

label.zh: 这对我们的帝国颇有裨益。
label.en: They will be a boon to our empire.

label.zh: 我们对这些科学家没什么兴趣。
label.en: We have no interest in these scientists.

texts.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]因其众多争执不休的王子们而臭名昭著，他们一直处心积虑想争取到每一点可以争取的影响力和权力。仅这一次他们似乎终于成功取得了一项共识，向我们派出了特使以期缔结新的外交条约。似乎他们开始怀念曾经[previous_overlord.GetName]给予的那种悉心呵护了。
texts.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] is known for their many quarreling princes, all desperately trying to grab hold of whatever influence and power they can. For once it seems they have finally managed to agree to something, and have sent envoys looking to make a new diplomatic pact with us. It seems they are missing the protection the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

label.zh: 行吧，至少他们能有点共识。
label.en: As long as they can agree to something.

label.zh: 我们对这群呱噪的家伙可没有半点兴趣。
label.en: We are not interested in their quarrels.

label.zh: 读法 1
label.en: Reading 1

label.zh: 读法 2

texts.zh: 在[previous_overlord.GetName]崩溃之前，[new_subject_target.GetName]与之颇为相近，似乎他们有兴趣与我们建立发展相似的关系。他们的外交官正在连夜撰写一份能令双方都满意签署的外交协定，作为我们两个帝国相互之间建立起更加充分的理解的第一步。
texts.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] was particularly close to [previous_overlord.GetName] before their dissolution, and it seems like they are interested in building a similar relationship to our empire moving forward. Now their diplomats are scrambling to finish a diplomatic deal both sides will be happy to sign, as the first step in building a better understanding between our two empires.

label.zh: 这儿会有他们的容身之所的。
label.en: We will find room for them.

label.zh: 请特使回去吧。
label.en: Send the envoys home.

texts.zh: 似乎[new_subject_target.GetName]的市场在[previous_overlord.GetName]解体后，有些不稳定。现在他们已经没有人可以依靠了。几位贸易巨头已与我们接触，并表示愿意提供[new_subject_target.GetAdj]劳役，甚至非常愿意献上部分利润，一旦他们的帝国稳定下来。
texts.en: It seems the markets of the [new_subject_target.GetName] have been somewhat unstable after the dissolution of the [previous_overlord.GetName], now that they no longer have someone to rely on for protection. Several trade princes have approached us and offered to support [new_subject_target.GetAdj] servitude, and even part of the profits that are sure to follow as their empire stabilizes once more.

label.zh: 只要他们能乖乖交上能量币就行。
label.en: As long as they can bring their energy credits.

label.zh: 我们不需要他们的资本财产。
label.en: We have no need of their capital wealth.
